author: nyx+znq19+萧洋
description: One browser plugin, two fully-symmetric backends, 12 action-based tools. Drives YOUR browser through the extension (real login state, zero conflict) or a plugin-owned headless Chromium. Both backends support read/click/type/JS/upload/download/cookies/keyboard/mouse. CPU/memory guarded, idle auto-close, page self-healing.

zh.description: 一个插件、两个能力完全对称的后端、12 个动作式工具。扩展连上就用你自己的浏览器（真实登录态、零冲突），没连上自动用插件自带的无头 Chromium。两个后端都支持 读/点击/输入/执行JS/上传/下载/Cookie/键盘鼠标 全套能力。含 CPU 内存防护、空闲自动关闭、页面自愈。
